job.title: Enterprise Architect/Lead Enterprise Architect
job.description:
Enterprise Architect/Lead Enterprise Architect - London (may be 1-2 days a week) and remote - global payments organisation!

Role
You will be high-calibre, technically broad Lead Enterprise Architect (EA). In this role, you will be the architectural anchor for a high-priority transformation portfolio: designing the multi-year infrastructure roadmap, driving the End-of-Life (EOL) decommissioning and re-platforming pipeline, and providing technical governance for our Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) remediation program. Combine deep infrastructure engineering with financial discipline, embedding FinOps frameworks across cloud and on-premise environments (ensure that every milestone on the strategic roadmap optimizes unit economics, eliminates waste during EOL migrations, and remains tightly aligned with corporate fiscal and security goals).
Core Key Responsibilities
  • Architect the target-state vision for a highly resilient hybrid environment, seamlessly blending on-premise data centers with multi-cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Assist in pre-sales as well as delivering IT roadmap created to remediated client Legacy environment into cloud-based environment where possible. This means person should possess skills to design AWS and Azure environments along with required security (IAM, Defender, Sentinel and PAM tools). Client is expecting for ISO27001 auditing. Infrastructure applications like Backup, Monitoring, Route 53 and Domain controllers along with EUC tools like InTune are the getting migrated as part of the project. Business application migration is out of scope.
  • Build & Govern the Strategic Roadmap: Design and maintain a phased, multi-year technology life cycle roadmap tracking infrastructure dependencies, technical debt, and aggressive EOL asset mitigation.
  • Drive FinOps & Cost Optimization: Establish cloud financial accountability by embedding FinOps practices into the architecture life cycle. Manage cloud spend, model TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) for EOL re-platforming options, and eliminate Legacy waste.
  • Champion ITDR Remediation: Provide primary technical and architectural governance for the Identity Threat Detection and Response program. Harden hybrid identity environments across Active Directory and cloud IDPs (Entra ID).
  • Guide & Influence Engineering Teams: Act as the ultimate technical bridge across diverse infrastructure silos (Compute, Storage, Network, IAM, Cloud). Confidently guide engineering execution toward compliant, budget-aware target states.
Technical Skills & Domain Expertise
1. Hybrid & Multi-Cloud Architecture
  • Extensive experience designing, deploying, and migrating applications across hybrid environments (On-Premises to Public Cloud: AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong grasp of container orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) to ensure consistency across cloud environments.
  • Proven track record of managing large-scale infrastructure decommissioning, hardware refreshes, and Legacy system modernization.
2. FinOps & Financial Modeling/Financials
  • Deep familiarity with the FinOps Framework (Inform, Optimize, Operate phases) and cloud cost management tooling (eg, AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, CloudHealth, Kubecost).
  • Capability to design architectures optimized for cost efficiency, incorporating spot instances, savings plans, auto-scaling parameters, and data egress optimization.
  • Strong capability to calculate TCO and ROI comparison models, guiding the team to select the most cost-effective cloud or hybrid landing zones for migrating EOL systems.
3. Identity & Cyber Resilience (ITDR Focus)
  • Advanced architectural knowledge of hybrid Identity & Access Management (IAM) ecosystems, including Active Directory tiering models, Entra ID, and PAM solutions (CyberArk, BeyondTrust).
  • Understanding of identity threat vectors and security posture assessment tools designed to detect privilege escalation, lateral movement, and misconfigurations.
Leadership & Strategy Capabilities
  • Financial & Technical Diplomat: Able to effectively bridge the gap between Enterprise IT Engineering, Finance (CFO office), and Procurement to drive cultural accountability around cloud spend.
  • Risk-Aware Decision Maker: Competent at balancing the urgency of security remediation (ITDR) and EOL risk management against immediate financial constraints and operational SLAs.
  • Architectural Communicator: Expert visual modeler (Miro, Visio, ArchiMate) capable of distilling complex infrastructure topologies and financial metrics into clear executive roadmaps.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience: Total of 15+ years of experience with 8+ years in an Enterprise, Cloud, or Infrastructure Architecture leadership role driving large hybrid cloud transformations.
  • Certifications (Highly Regarded):
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Enterprise Architect.
  • TOGAF, Zachman, or SAFe framework certifications.
  • Professional Cloud Architect certifications (eg, AWS Certified Solutions Architect Pro, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect).

job.title: AI Solutions Architect
job.description:

  • Design and govern the AI platform architecture: model orchestration, prompt and context management, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, agent frameworks, and tool/context integration (including emerging protocols such as MCP)
  • Define and enforce responsible AI, governance, and assurance frameworks - covering bias, safety, data privacy, and model risk - aligned to client and regulatory requirements
  • Lead and mentor a team of AI engineers and architects, building technical capability and clear career pathways within the practice
  • Own technical relationships with hyperscaler and frontier model partners (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic, OpenAI) to stay ahead of platform capability
  • Drive reusable accelerators, frameworks, and IP that can be repeated and scaled across client engagements
  • Act as a trusted advisor to client CxOs and senior stakeholders on AI strategy, architecture, and roadmap
  • Own end-to-end delivery quality: architecture reviews, technical governance boards, production readiness, and post-go-live scaling
  • Contribute to thought leadership - whitepapers, conference contributions, and internal capability-building
Required Skills & Experience
  • 10+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or solution architecture, including at least 3-5 years focused specifically on applied AI/ML or generative AI
  • Proven, hands-on architecture experience with frontier large language models and multi-modal models - including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, and agentic/multi-agent system design
  • Strong grounding in LLMOps/MLOps: evaluation frameworks, observability, cost and latency optimisation, guardrails, and safe deployment at enterprise scale
  • Direct experience with major frontier model providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, or equivalent) and cloud AI ecosystems (Azure AI/OpenAI Service, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI)
  • Solid understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, and emerging regulatory frameworks (eg EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, or regional equivalents)
  • Demonstrated technical leadership - leading architecture teams, chairing design/technical governance authorities, mentoring senior engineers
  • Client-facing consulting experience: solutioning, pre-sales support, and stakeholder management at senior client level
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: API design, cloud-native architecture, microservices, and data pipeline/data engineering experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; an advanced degree is a plus
Preferred/Desirable Skills
  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (eg LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and emerging tool-integration protocols (eg Model Context Protocol)
  • Public sector or other regulated-industry delivery experience (financial services, healthcare, government)
  • Relevant certifications (eg Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional ML Engineer)
  • Experience building or scaling an AI Centre of Excellence or comparable practice capability within a consulting organisation
  • Published thought leadership, patents, or conference speaking in AI/ML

job.title: .NET Solutions Architect (SC)
job.description:
Solution Architect (.NET) - SC Cleared - London/hybrid
Essential
  • 10+ years' experience in software engineering or architecture, including 3+ years as a solution/technical architect on multi-service platforms.
  • Proven track record designing technology modernisation - defining target-state architectures and migration paths from Legacy applications and infrastructure to currently supported, cloud-native patterns.
  • Strong architectural grounding in .NET/.NET Core, with working knowledge of Python and modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue.js, React).
  • Experience designing solutions using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and containerised deployment (Docker) at scale.
  • Experience architecting with AWS managed services (RDS, SQS, DynamoDB, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, ECR) and applying the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
  • Experience designing with identity, authentication and API gateway technologies (eg WSO2, RADIUS-based systems, or equivalents).
  • Experience operating in a regulated, security-conscious or public-sector environment, with a strong understanding of data minimisation, data protection and audit requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce clear architecture artefacts (HLDs/LLDs, ADRs, solution diagrams) and to defend them at governance boards.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, able to translate architectural trade-offs into business impact for senior and non-technical audiences.
Desirable
  • Experience architecting law-enforcement, intelligence, or regulatory case-management platforms.
  • Familiarity with WSO2 API Gateway/IdAM, ClamAV or similar security tooling.
  • Experience architecting data-science/ML tooling (SageMaker) or search/analytics platforms in an analytical-toolset context.
  • Relevant security clearance, or the ability to obtain one.
  • TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional), or an equivalent architecture certification.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
  • TOGAF (or an equivalent enterprise/solution architecture framework) certification is desirable; AWS Certified Solutions Architect is also desirable.
Role
Solution & Technical Architecture
  • Act as the technical design authority for the platform, producing and maintaining high-level and detailed solution designs across its core service domains.
  • Define target-state architecture for the platform's mixed .NET Core, Python and JavaScript/TypeScript (Vue.js, React) estate, ensuring new solutions are consistent with agreed patterns and standards.
  • Design integration patterns across the containerisation (Docker), reverse-Proxy/API layer (OpenResty, Nginx) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) tooling.
  • Design and govern integration with identity, authentication and security platforms (LinOTP, RADIUS, WSO2 IdAM, WSO2 API Gateway, ClamAV), ensuring solutions meet authentication, authorisation and malware-scanning requirements.
  • Produce architecture decision records (ADRs), solution diagrams and non-functional requirement (NFR) specifications for significant changes.
Technology Modernisation & Target-State Roadmap
  • Own the target-state architecture and modernisation roadmap for the platform, identifying and sequencing remediation of end-of-life or unsupported components (for example, the current Terraform estate).
  • Assess the long-term viability of Legacy application components - including the .NET WPF desktop application and the dual Front End framework footprint (Vue.js and React) - and produce architecture recommendations on consolidation, retirement or re-platforming.
  • Evaluate and recommend use of managed AWS services (SQS, DynamoDB, SageMaker, OpenSearch, FSx, WorkSpaces, ECR) against in-house build, applying AWS Well-Architected principles.
  • Maintain a technology radar/roadmap for the estate, flagging obsolescence and security risk to programme governance.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
Global client are looking for a hands-on Senior Data Engineer/Power BI Developer to design, build and support enterprise analytics solutions across trading, risk, finance and post-trade reporting.

The role requires strong engineering discipline across Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, with the ability to turn complex business requirements into reliable, scalable and well-governed data products.

Essential skills.
Databricks - Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, notebooks, workflows, cluster tuning and production-grade PySpark development.
Microsoft Fabric - Lakehouse, OneLake, shortcuts, Dataflow Gen2, Fabric notebooks, Direct Lake and SQL Analytics Endpoint.
Power BI - DAX, semantic modelling, Power Query M, RLS, incremental refresh, aggregation strategy and performance tuning.
SQL - Advanced SQL, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, optimisation and large-volume analytical processing.
Azure Data Platform - ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Git integration, DevOps pipelines and secure cloud engineering practices.
Delivery Mindset - Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, issue resolution and p[rductiopn support experience.

﻿Key Responsibilities.
Design, develop and optimise ETL and ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks, PySpark, Python and SQL.
Build curated Delta Lake and Lakehouse data products using medallion architecture principles.
Create Microsoft Fabric Lakehouses, notebooks, Dataflow Gen2 ingestion flows and Direct Lake reporting models.
Develop enterprise Power BI datasets, semantic models and dashboards using advanced DAX, Power Query M and star schema modelling.
Implement row-level security, access controls, validation checks and governance standards for production reporting.
Optimise SQL, Spark, Fabric and Power BI workloads for performance, maintainability and cost efficiency.
Work closely with business users, traders, risk teams and finance stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver production-ready solutions.
Support release management, CI/CD, documentation and operational monitoring using Git and Azure DevOps.
